閉殻Hartree–Fock方程式

note.ja: 閉殻RHFの占有空間軌道の式で、非局所交換を含む。既存のHe局所還元とH2のRHF例を保持する。追加は固定H2/H3+の最小2電子模型で、UHF式は別の対応模型に明示する。一般多中心分子、開殻の大域安定性、完全基底や一般相関法の保証ではない。 この問題に関連する代表式です。初期条件・境界条件・パラメータは「図と問題の条件・根拠」と各実行例で確認できます。
note.en: Closed-shell occupied-orbital RHF equations include nonlocal exchange. Preserve existing He local-reduction and H2RHF examples. New calculations cover only fixed minimal two-electron H2/H3+ models; UHF equations have their own mapped model. No general multicenter molecules, global open-shell stability, complete-basis or general correlated-method guarantee. Representative equations related to this problem. See the image/problem conditions and each execution example for initial conditions, boundary conditions and parameters.

name.ja: 電子の定常Schrödinger方程式

note.ja: 固定核・非相対論の電子固有値問題。核間反発は電子Hamiltonianの外に加える。従来の水素型動径例を保持し、追加は1次元の箱/HOと3AO以下の2電子FCIに限定する。一般多電子系の直接解法や連続空間の厳密分子解の検証ではない。 この問題に関連する代表式です。初期条件・境界条件・パラメータは「図と問題の条件・根拠」と各実行例で確認できます。
note.en: Fixed-nuclei nonrelativistic electronic eigenproblems; add nuclear repulsion separately. Preserve the existing hydrogenic radial examples. Additional examples are restricted to one-dimensional box/HO and two-electron FCI in at most3AOs, not general many-electron direct solvers or continuum-exact molecules. Representative equations related to this problem. See the image/problem conditions and each execution example for initial conditions, boundary conditions and parameters.

name.ja: 最小2電子模型のスピン非制限HF
name.en: Unrestricted HF in a minimal two-electron model

note.ja: 2固定距離のみ。有限基底FCIは連続空間の厳密解ではなく、UHF定常解の一般的な大域最小性は保証しません。角運動量・完全基底・広い解離曲線は未検証。 この問題に関連する代表式です。初期条件・境界条件・パラメータは「図と問題の条件・根拠」と各実行例で確認できます。
note.en: Only2fixed distances. Finite-basis FCI is not continuum exactness, and UHF stationarity is not a general global-minimum guarantee. Angular/complete-basis convergence and a broad dissociation curve remain untested. Representative equations related to this problem. See the image/problem conditions and each execution example for initial conditions, boundary conditions and parameters.

note.en: Semi-analytic reference Explicit unchanged STO-3G s contraction, R1.4/3.0bohr, finite-basis FCI and broken-spin UHF; not exact continuum chemistry. Distances1.4/3.0bohr and total energies in hartree. Two electrons in2AOs, each an explicitly supplied three-primitive contracted Hs function. Only2fixed distances. Finite-basis FCI is not continuum exactness, and UHF stationarity is not a general global-minimum guarantee. Angular/complete-basis convergence and a broad dissociation curve remain untested.
